reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the change to surface frame-read failures between tables. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #360 by ensuring query v2 `IterativeDataset` reports frame-read failures between tables instead of silently treating interrupted responses as complete. **Changes:** - Return frame-read errors directly from the primary-table loop, eliminating the shadowed error variable. - Add regression tests for complete responses and failures during or immediately after a table, verifying error propagation and preservation of the completed row. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `azkustodata/​query/​v2/​read_error_test.go` | Tests error reporting and row preservation through the public result channels. | | `azkustodata/​query/​v2/​iterative_dataset.go` | Returns frame-read errors encountered between tables. |
Review effort: Max
